function poll(host): Promise<void>;

Defined in: cms/media-convert/job.ts:93

One poll tick: fetches job status, re-arms the timer while the server reports running/uploading, and finishes (or errors) on a terminal state. A failed GET is treated as server loss — the phase flips to ERROR rather than polling forever.

Parameters

host

CmsMediaConverter

The CmsMediaConverter element.
